title: Unit Event — Lead to Shine More — Episode7 All Together

meta.Event Outline: With more work offers coming in for MORE MORE JUMP! than they can fulfill, Haruka and the others have a serious talk about their work priorities moving forward.

rows.Line: Hanamioka Town Hall

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Chairman!

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line:
Ah, MORE MORE JUMP!
I apologize for having you all gather on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's okay. Are we really running short on bookmarks?

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Member
rows.Line: Yes, more runners than we were expecting have applied, so it looks like we're not going to have enough to go around...

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: We were hoping to give everybody one, but we may need to start considering a first-come-first-serve policy.

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Member
rows.Line: It's such a shame. We were hoping everyone could go home with a beautiful little memory of our town.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line:
That's why we began holding the town marathon.
Showing people just how beautiful this place is should help bring in more tourists and new residents...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Pardon me!

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Member
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can you tell us how many bookmarks we're currently short?

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Member
rows.Line: How many? I'd say about 400 would cover it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. A hundred per person, then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're right!

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Member
rows.Line: Wait, what are you saying?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's still enough time for each of us to make a hundred more. Then, we'll have enough for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Member
rows.Line:
B-But!
We couldn't possibly ask you to go that far...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's okay! We're the ones who suggested that we pass out bookmarks in the first place!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please let us do this.
We want to put smiles on the faces of everyone in this town and all those who participate in the marathon.

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Member
rows.Line: Girls...

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Member
rows.Line:
Then, please do.
I'd love to help out, but we still have things to do for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay. You can leave this to us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's start by checking how many extra flowers we have. If we need more...

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: I can ask the flower shop to see if they have the ones we're using. I'll do something about the budget.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
In that case, we should be able to dry them out in time by using the microwave.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, Airi, Shizuku, could you two check our reserves and go with the chairman to get the flowers we need?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, can you gather up all the tools so we can get started right away? I'll bring the materials.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'll help you carry everything!

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line:
...
Keep the cameras rolling.

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: O-Of course!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that makes about twenty total.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, that's a lot already!
Though, we still have a long way to go until 400.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, that means we gotta really get cracking!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but we should also make each one with care.
Oh, you're really going at it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Members
rows.Line: Honestly, why didn't you come tell us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Everyone!
But what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: We should be asking you that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line:
Are they sure about this?
I mean, they're idols, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We apologize for doing this without consulting you all, but...

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: If the chairman hadn't told us, then you would've ended up doing all the work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line: Ah, don't look at us like that.

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line:
I understand why you'd be hesitant.
We didn't exactly welcome you with open arms.

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line: We thought you and that television crew were really just here for some feel-good footage.

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line: But when we actually bothered looking...

rows.Speaker: Local B
rows.Line: You've all worked so hard for our town.

rows.Speaker: Local B
rows.Line: Even when the cameras weren't on, you got muddy harvesting crops and you built that big stage. I honestly couldn't believe my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Local B
rows.Line: But it made us really happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line:
Besides, this is our town.
That means it's our duty to act.

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: Right. What we mean to say is...

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: Let's do this, together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That's so great to hear.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's normal for them to be wary of outsiders and those they think they can't rely on. Their town is just that precious to them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, it's up to us to be the best diplomats we can, to help ease their worries.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have to take this marathon and our interactions with the locals very seriously. We need to show them that we're going to do our absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Our feelings made it through to them.)

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Members
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, your flowers are lined up so nicely. Can you show me how to do that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
You see, even if the flowers stick out a little at first, they'll shrink into position like this.

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Members
rows.Line: Oh, so that's the trick!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, you don't necessarily have to line them up in a row. You can actually layer them together too...
